block.instructions:
Write a general algorithmic CLI clone; do not hardcode the sampled names or consult the filesystem to resolve paths. Preserve argument bytes where the implementation language permits. Parse options only before the first operand. Recognize -a, -s, -z, their documented long forms, unambiguous long abbreviations, short-option clusters, attached -s values, --suffix=VALUE and separate suffix values. A suffix option consumes the rest of its cluster or the next argument verbatim, enables multiple mode, and replaces any earlier suffix setting. Recognize -- as an option terminator only while parsing options; a lone '-' is an operand. Handle --help and --version immediately when encountered during option parsing. Reject unknown options, missing required values and values attached to no-argument long options. After parsing, require at least one operand. Without multiple mode, allow one NAME and at most one positional SUFFIX; reject a third operand before printing anything. With multiple mode, every remaining operand is a NAME and only the option-provided suffix applies. For each NAME: preserve empty input as empty; remove trailing '/' bytes; if the original nonempty name consists entirely of slashes, return '/'; otherwise take everything after the last remaining '/'. Do not normalize '.', '..', repeated internal separators, backslashes or drive prefixes. If a nonempty suffix is a strict shorter byte-for-byte ending of the component, remove exactly one copy; otherwise leave the component unchanged. Emit each result literally followed by newline, or NUL when -z is active, including the final result and empty results. Return 0 on successful processing. Match status 1 and stderr diagnostics for invalid invocations; observed operand errors use 'basename: missing operand' or 'basename: extra operand ‘VALUE’', followed by newline and "Try '/usr/bin/basename --help' for more information." plus newline. Observed option-parser diagnostics use /usr/bin/basename as the prefix. Keep executable-name substitution and locale-sensitive diagnostic quoting separate from the path algorithm. Validate independently against the reference using the cited probe matrix and generated combinations of arbitrary component lengths, repeated slashes, suffix lengths/equality/mismatch/repetition, empty operands, option clusters and option-like operands. Compare stdout bytes, stderr and status. Investigate the explicitly unprobed behaviors if full CLI parity is required; do not assume their exact output from these observations.
Produce artifact.files["main.ts"] as a complete Bun CLI implementation, with no external commands or dependencies. Parse process.argv.slice(2), write stdout and exit status. The reference command is available through run_tool target. Handle -a/--multiple, -s/--suffix including --suffix=..., -z/--zero, combined short options, -- separator, single-operand optional suffix, errors. No lookup tables; handle arbitrary path strings algorithmically. Match stdout and exit status; stderr text, --help, --version and filesystem input are outside this contract. Previous verification reports contain feedback for retries.
